posts.en:
dsh-agentmemory is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c90118fb4d2a9c20e13b.html
